title: The Forgotten Spire Revisited
author: Mirabel Thornbury
blurb: Zephyrine Thornbury, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
